newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-NZ'S BLUES HOLD OFF WELLINGTON.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-NZ'S BLUES HOLD OFF WELLINGTON.

text.p: The Auckland Blues held off a strong finish by Wellington to win 45-42 in an exhilarating Super 12 rugby match here at Eden Park on Saturday.
In a match of swinging fortunes both sides profited from having a strong All Black presence in their respective tight five forwards.

Early in the match Auckland trailed 16-3 before a try-scoring spree either side of halftime enabled them to bound away to a 35-16 lead which Wellington then bravely tried to pull back through to the final whistle.

The win earned Auckland a home semifinal while Wellington, with two bonus points from this game, have a strong chance to beat the ACT Brumbies when they play at Wellington to claim second spot and the other home semifinal.

"I think we'll come back better next week for this game,'' Hurricanes coach Frank Oliver said. "This is one loss from which we will learn a lot, but I don't know if you can ever come back a better side against Auckland."
The Hurricanes scored the first try when, after a series of rucks inside the Auckland 22, fullback Christian Cullen sent his skipper and prop Mark Allen over the line.
A conversion and three penalties to Jon Preston to two Carlos Spencer penalties had Wellington ahead 16-6 nine minutes before the halftime break.

But the Blues struck twice three minutes from halftime with tighthead prop Craig Dowd ploughing over the line on the short side from a ruck on the Hurricanes goal line, followed up by Spencer carving through to the line from a midfield ruck on the Wellington 22 to level the scores at the break.
In seven minutes after the restart the Blues were at their deadly best as Auckland drove from a lineout for Zinzan Brooke to score.

While Oliver believes his team will regroup and come out stronger against the ACT next weekend, Auckland coach Henry aims to rest some of his regular players next week against New South Wales in Sydney.

Wellington Hurricanes: Christian Cullen, Alex Telea, Mark Ranby, Tana Umaga, Jason O'Halloran, Stephen Bachop, Jon Preston, Filo Tiatia, Martin Leslie, Mark Cooksley, Mike Russell, Chresten Davis, Phil Coffin, Norman Hewitt, Mark Allen (captain). Reserves: Richard Jarman, Jarrod Cunningham, Finau Maka, Kevin Barrett, Tala Leiasamaivao, Bill Cavubati.

Auckland Blues: Adrian Cashmore, Joeli Vidiri, Eroni Clarke, Brian Lima, Lee Stensness, Carlos Spencer, Ofisa Tonu'u, Zinzan Brooke (captain), Mark Carter, Robin Brooke, Leo Lafaiali'i, Michael Jones, Craig Dowd, Sean Fitzpatrick, Paul Thomson.
